name: Aptitude
description: Quantitative aptitude is the first filter at almost every service company (TCS NQT, Infosys, Wipro, Accenture, Cognizant) and in many product-company OAs. Speed plus accuracy here decides who even reaches the coding rounds.

sampleQuestions.q: A train 240 m long passes a pole in 24 s. What is its speed?
A shopkeeper marks goods 40% above cost price and gives a 10% discount. What is his profit %?
A alone finishes a job in 12 days and B alone in 24 days. Working together, how many days do they need?
sampleQuestions.answer: 8 days - together they do 1/12 + 1/24 = 1/8 of the job per day.

sampleQuestions.q: Two dice are thrown. What is the probability that the sum of the numbers is 7?
sampleQuestions.answer: 1/6 - there are 6 favourable outcomes out of 36 total.

sampleQuestions.q: Find the simple interest on Rs. 5,000 at 8% per annum for 3 years.

name: Verbal Ability
description: Verbal rounds (TCS email writing, Deloitte Versant, Accenture English ability) eliminate more candidates than coding does. Reading comprehension and sentence correction decide shortlists at every service company.

sampleQuestions.q: Choose the correct word: 'He is one of the best players ___ has ever played for India.'
sampleQuestions.answer: 'that' - superlative constructions take 'that' as the relative pronoun.

sampleQuestions.q: Spot the error: 'One of my friend lives in Pune.'
sampleQuestions.answer: 'friend' should be 'friends' - 'one of' is always followed by a plural noun.

sampleQuestions.q: Give a synonym of 'Abate'.
sampleQuestions.answer: Subside / diminish - e.g., 'The storm began to abate by evening.'

sampleQuestions.q: Give an antonym of 'Frugal'.
sampleQuestions.answer: Extravagant - frugal means careful with money, extravagant means spending freely.

sampleQuestions.q: Fill in the blank: 'Despite ___ unwell, she completed the presentation on time.'
sampleQuestions.answer: 'being' - 'despite' is followed by a gerund (-ing form), not a clause.

name: CS Fundamentals
description: The technical interview warm-up at product companies and the main course at service companies: OS, DBMS, OOP and Networks get asked in almost every campus technical round.

resources.name: GeeksforGeeks Last Minute Notes - Operating Systems

sampleQuestions.q: What is a deadlock? State the four necessary conditions.
sampleQuestions.answer: Two or more processes block forever waiting on each other's resources. Conditions: mutual exclusion, hold & wait, no preemption, circular wait.

sampleQuestions.q: What is the difference between a process and a thread?
sampleQuestions.answer: A process has its own address space; threads of a process share its memory. Threads are lighter to create, switch and communicate with.

sampleQuestions.q: What is normalization in DBMS and why do we need it?
sampleQuestions.answer: Organizing tables to reduce redundancy and avoid update/insert/delete anomalies, using normal forms 1NF, 2NF, 3NF and BCNF.

sampleQuestions.q: TCP vs UDP - what does TCP guarantee that UDP does not?
sampleQuestions.answer: TCP is connection-oriented with reliable, ordered, error-checked delivery and retransmission; UDP is connectionless and faster but gives no delivery guarantee.

sampleQuestions.q: What are the four pillars of OOP?
sampleQuestions.answer: Encapsulation, Abstraction, Inheritance and Polymorphism.

name: SQL Top 50
description: SQL is the most-asked non-DSA skill in Indian campus drives - Cognizant GenC Elevate, Infosys, Accenture and analyst roles at Deloitte all test joins and aggregates. The LeetCode SQL 50 plan covers every pattern you need.

sampleQuestions.q: Recyclable and Low-Fat Products
sampleQuestions.answer: SELECT product_id FROM Products WHERE low_fats = 'Y' AND recyclable = 'N';

sampleQuestions.q: Find Customer Referee
sampleQuestions.answer: SELECT name FROM Customer WHERE referee_id IS NULL OR referee_id <> 2;

sampleQuestions.q: Combine Two Tables
sampleQuestions.answer: SELECT p.firstName, p.lastName, a.city, a.state FROM Person p LEFT JOIN Address a ON p.personId = a.personId;

sampleQuestions.q: Duplicate Emails
sampleQuestions.answer: SELECT email FROM Person GROUP BY email HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

sampleQuestions.q: Second Highest Salary
sampleQuestions.answer: SELECT MAX(salary) AS SecondHighestSalary FROM Employee WHERE salary < (SELECT MAX(salary) FROM Employee);
